title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of Glow Shakes Premium Collagen Meal Replacement on Body Composition, Weight Management, Skin, Hair, Nail, Gut, and Overall Health Outcomes
official: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of Glow Shakes Premium Collagen Meal Replacement on Body Composition, Weight Management, Skin, Hair, Nail, Gut, and Overall Health Outcomes
summary:
This is a single-group, open-label, decentralized clinical trial evaluating the effects of 6 weeks of daily Glow Shakes Premium Collagen Meal Replacement consumption on body composition, weight management, and self-reported health outcomes in 40 adults aged 18-55 years with a BMI between 25-35 kg/m².

All participants will consume Glow Shakes Premium Collagen Meal Replacement twice daily, replacing two typical meals, for 6 consecutive weeks. Assessments will be conducted at Baseline, Week 2, Week 4, and Week 6 and will include validated self-report questionnaires and body composition measurements via the Withings smart scale. All study activities are conducted remotely; products are shipped directly to participants' homes and all data are submitted digitally through the Citruslabs study platform.

interventions.name: Glow Shakes Premium Collagen Meal Replacement Intervention

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 18-55 years at the time of enrollment.
* BMI between 25-35 kg/m² at screening, as confirmed via participant self-report and/or Withings smart scale measurement at Baseline.
* Self-reported goals around weight management, body composition improvement, or overall health and wellness at the time of enrollment.
* Willing and able to use Glow Shakes Premium Collagen Meal Replacement as a daily meal replacement (replacing two typical meals) for 6 consecutive weeks and to complete all questionnaire assessments and Withings smart scale body composition measurements at Baseline, Week 2, Week 4, and Week 6.
* Willing to maintain current diet (except for the test product), exercise routine, and lifestyle habits for the duration of the 6-week study, without introducing any new supplements or products specifically targeting weight loss, appetite, or body composition.
* In good general health.
* Resides in the United States.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or breastfeeding at the time of enrollment, or planning to become pregnant during the 6-week study period.
* Currently using GLP-1 receptor agonists, dual-incretin medications, prescription weight loss drugs, or any other prescription medication directly affecting appetite or body weight.
* Known allergy or intolerance to any ingredient in the Glow Shakes formulation, including milk protein, whey protein, or collagen-derived (bovine) ingredients.
* Diagnosed with a serious medical condition requiring medical nutritional management, including but not limited to Type 1 diabetes, active cancer, or severe renal or hepatic disease.
* Currently testing, or plan to in the next 6 weeks, a product for another research study.
